Midnight, phone down, one haunted house to color instead. 🖤

The Grimdark Horror book has 200 pages of haunted houses, twisted creatures, gothic scenes and nightmare landscapes, all in deeply detailed line art. I made it for adults who love the darker side.

Pick one page. Take your time with it. The scroll can wait until tomorrow.

You'll get a print-ready PDF plus 300 DPI PNG files, sized for A4 and 8.5 x 11 in. It's an instant digital download.
